load_imagenet_dataset: load an ImageNet dataset split with preprocessing, augmentation, and batching for training or evaluation
apply_cutmix_augmentation: apply CutMix augmentation to a batch of images by randomly patching regions from paired samples
apply_mixup_augmentation: apply MixUp augmentation to a batch of images by linearly interpolating paired samples with a Beta ratio
apply_mixup_and_cutmix: apply MixUp to half the batch and CutMix to the other half simultaneously
generate_cutmix_mask: generate a binary image mask for CutMix with a random rectangular patch and uniform proportion
